title: PC POWER K98 RGB Gaming Mechanical Keyboard (White)

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Elevate your gaming and typing experience with the PC POWER K98 RGB Gaming Mechanical Keyboard, designed for precision, speed, and style. Equipped with high-quality mechanical switches, this keyboard delivers fast, tactile feedback and outstanding durability, perfect for both professional gamers and everyday users.

Featuring customizable RGB backlighting, the K98 lets you personalize your keyboard with vibrant lighting effects and multiple color modes, enhancing your gaming setup's aesthetics. Its full-size layout with dedicated multimedia keys ensures seamless control and convenience.

Built for performance, the keyboard includes anti-ghosting technology and N-key rollover, guaranteeing every keystroke registers accurately—even during intense gaming sessions. The sturdy, ergonomic design ensures comfort for prolonged use, making the PC POWER K98 a reliable companion for work and play.

Key Features:

  • Mechanical Switches: Fast, tactile, and durable for responsive typing and gaming
  • RGB Backlighting: Customizable multi-color lighting with dynamic effects
  • Full-Size Layout: Includes multimedia and function keys for enhanced productivity
  • Anti-Ghosting & N-Key Rollover: 100% accurate key recognition during fast inputs
  • Ergonomic Design: Comfortable for long hours of gaming or typing
  • Durable Build: High-quality materials for long-lasting performance
  • Plug & Play: Easy USB connection, compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux
